evidence: XPS of the as-deposited film was studied to understand the chemical nature and electronic state of the material. Raman spectra of the as-deposited MoOx film are presented. Microscopy study with scanning electron microscope (SEM) and transmission electron microscope (TEM) showed the conformal coating of MoOx throughout the 3D MWCNT scaffold structure. Ex situ X-ray diffraction (XRD) and XPS were done at different potential along with CV to get specific information about lithiation/delithiation mechanism in commercial α-MoO3. Cyclic voltammetry (CV) experiments were performed. Electrochemical Impedance Spectra of 300 ALD cycle bare MoOx and MoOx/CNT electrode showed charge transfer resistance (R ct). Charge–discharge characteristics of all four different MoOx coated MWCNT electrodes were carried out. SEM images of MWCNTs after different ALD cycles were shown. High-resolution TEM (HRTEM) was performed. Electrochemical Cell Fabrication: All the electrochemical characterizations were done in 2032 coin cells in a half-cell assembly. Cyclic voltammetry measurements were carried out with Biologic VMP-3, France, while the charge–discharge measurements were performed in BT-2000 test station, Arbin Instruments, USA. All the electrochemical measurements were taken at a constant temperature of 20 °C ± 1 accuracy.
